arguments.prompt: Design a professional SaaS dashboard for a building materials export platform called YouDing. Primary brand color: mint green (#4a9b8c). Background: white (#FFFFFF) with light gray (#F9FAFB) page background. Layout: Left sidebar (240px, white) with logo, navigation groups (Workspace, Business, SEO Matrix, AI Center) using line icons, active item has mint green left accent bar. Top bar (56px) with page title, search box (Ctrl+K), notification bell, user avatar. Main content: 4 KPI cards in a row (Inquiries 1284 +12.5%, Countries 47 +3, Content 356 +8.2%, GEO Score 82 +5pts) each with mini sparkline. Area chart for weekly activity trend. Donut chart for feature usage. Todo list with priority dots. Quick action grid with 6 buttons. Data table with products. Use Inter font, 12px border-radius cards, subtle shadows, 8px grid spacing. Clean and minimal, only mint green and gray colors.
